defects.note: ', ' (two characters, so not the excluded single-character case) joined three times on separate lines
string literal containing a keyword and a semicolon repeated in IF/ELSIF/ELSE inside a labelled block
defects.code:
PROCEDURE @@proc@@ (p_kind IN VARCHAR2, p_out OUT VARCHAR2) IS
BEGIN
    <<pick>>
    BEGIN
        IF p_kind IS NULL THEN
            p_out := 'end;@@str@@'; -- @expect
        ELSIF LENGTH(p_kind) > 3 THEN
            p_out := 'end;@@str@@'; -- @expect
        ELSE
            p_out := 'end;@@str@@'; -- @expect
        END IF;
    END pick;
END @@proc@@;

each literal exactly twice in code; further occurrences only in a comment and inside different, longer string literals
